titre: [$175] Concierge: numbered format displayed when user ask "What can you do? Use the list format"
corps:

To join our Slack channel, fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/Q7hnhUJPnQCK7Fe56). ___ **Version Number:** v9.5.53-0 **Reproducible in staging?:** Yes **Reproducible in production?:** Yes **If this was caught during regression testing, add the test name, ID and link from BrowserStack:** https://test-management.browserstack.com/projects/2219752/folder/22315296/test-cases/83669985 **Email or phone of affected tester (no customers):** noiratnang@gmail.com **Issue reported by:** Applause Internal Team **Bug source:** Regression TC Execution **Device used:** window 11/Chrome **App Component:** Other ## Action Performed: 1. Open the link www.staging.new.expensify.com 2. User sign in with brand new account without + 3. Onboarding >> Select 10-50 >> Select QBO 4. Navigate to Inbox >> Concierge >> ask a question "How do I set up QuickBooks?" 5. Wait for the Concierge to think and reply 6. In the same Conversation thread Ask a question like  "What can you do? Use the list format" 7. Wait for the Concierge to think and reply 8. in the same conversation thread Ask a question like  "What can you do? Use the numbered format" 9. Wait for the Concierge to think and reply ## Expected Result: When the user asks "What can you do? Use the list format", Concierge should display the response using a bullet list format. When the user asks "What can you do? Use the numbered format", Concierge should display the response using a numbered list format. ## Actual Result: When the user asks "What can you do? Code evidence and alternatives checked - App uses separate renderers for `
    ` and `
      `: [RenderHTML.tsx:75–106](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d7c37c01c1f789576fce663d34cc8255e4a55f51/src/components/RenderHTML.tsx#L75-L106). - Unordered lists use bullet-item rendering: [ULRenderer.tsx:20–28](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d7c37c01c1f789576fce663d34cc8255e4a55f51/src/components/HTMLEngineProvider/HTMLRenderers/ULRenderer.tsx#L20-L28). Ordered items explicitly render numeric markers: [NumberedItemRenderer.tsx:13–20](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d7c37c01c1f789576fce663d34cc8255e4a55f51/src/components/HTMLEngineProvider/HTMLRenderers/NumberedItemRenderer.tsx#L13-L20). - A streaming/final-response discrepancy remains possible: App parses intermediate Markdown but prefers supplied final HTML when available: [conciergeDraftState.ts:614–638](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d7c37c01c1f789576fce663d34cc8255e4a55f51/src/pages/inbox/conciergeDraftState.ts#L614-L638). No bullet-to-number rewrite was identified in the inspected path. However, the reported response payload was unavailable, and production-log tools were unavailable, so code inspection cannot confirm what happened here.
**Next diagnostic:** Repeat with the required account and explicitly request “a bulleted, unordered list.” Capture the intermediate Markdown and final response HTML. If valid `
    ` content displays numbers, investigate App rendering; if the response already contains `
      ` or numbered text, investigate response generation/formatting with an internal engineer. No code fix is verified yet. --- _[view run](https://github.com/Expensify/melvin/actions/runs/45329436278)_ · _[view recording](https://melvinbot-assets.exops.io/session-45329436278-1-2bee9f20-3f65-4c83-977f-9e7a552a50cd.webm)_
I can reproduce this on the dev environment. I'm checking it now. @MelvinBot, please propose a fix.

> ⚠️ **Preliminary analysis — an App-side fix is not yet verified.**

The screenshot confirms the symptom, but not where the numbering originates. “List format” can describe either bullets or numbers; App does not interpret that instruction itself.

<details>
<summary>Code evidence</summary>

- App renders unordered lists with bullets and ordered lists with numbers through separate renderers: [ULRenderer.tsx:20–28](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d7c37c01c1f789576fce663d34cc8255e4a55f51/src/components/HTMLEngineProvider/HTMLRenderers/ULRenderer.tsx#L20-L28), [OLRenderer.tsx:25–38](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d7c37c01c1f789576fce663d34cc8255e4a55f51/src/components/HTMLEngineProvider/HTMLRenderers/OLRenderer.tsx#L25-L38).
- During streaming, App parses Markdown; when final HTML arrives, it takes precedence: [conciergeDraftState.ts:614–638](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d7c37c01c1f789576fce663d34cc8255e4a55f51/src/pages/inbox/conciergeDraftState.ts#L614-L638).
- No bullet-to-number conversion was found in the inspected path.

</details>

**Before choosing a fix:** capture the reproduced reply’s streaming Markdown and final response HTML.

- **Already numbered in the payload:** escalate to an internal engineer to investigate Concierge’s response generation outside App.
- **Unordered in the payload but numbered onscreen:** that establishes an App rendering/conversion defect to fix.
- **Bullets while streaming, numbers after completion:** compare the streaming Markdown with final HTML to locate the boundary.

I could not retrieve that payload: log tools are unavailable, and the screenshot is from a separate dev environment. **Changing App to force bullets now would risk breaking explicitly requested numbered lists.** No verified code fix can be proposed from the screenshot alone.

`.
